_comment: MERGE these two keys into the existing "hooks" object in .claude/settings.json.
Do not replace the file: it already declares PreToolUse, and this fragment does not.
The existing permissions.deny already covers Edit(.claude/hooks/**) and
Write(.claude/hooks/**), so both new scripts inherit that protection with no
Exec form ("command": "node" + "args") is used deliberately, matching the three
shipped hooks: no shell is involved on either platform, so there is no sh -c
quoting on Linux and no PowerShell quoting on Windows to get wrong.
The SubagentStop matcher matches the agent_type field (verified against the
installed Claude Code build), so "reviewer" selects the Reviewer subagent.
